discovery_notes: Follow-up 8 of B007 (packets 207, 413, 456, 489, 513, 534, 554, 571); reuses their keys. 29 standard searches, snippets only. New pins (3): HKDL 14th Cookie boat-captain (DPB per-design, held as possible duplicate of Aug CookieAnn), TDS Pixar Playtime 2019 pin (MezzoMiki/Castel, 1,000 yen), TDL wedding Mickey & Minnie heart pin (MezzoMiki, 1,400 yen, held as possible duplicate of TDR Valentine 2019). Added Jul-Sep presale package dates. No holds released. SHDR monthly 6-10, booster, 3rd anniv, Ant-Man, Graduation, Oct-Dec bulletin, December eight, PIN-GO Eeyore/Roo, LE 300/400 keys unresolved. Carousell, USShoppingSOS, dpinstore not used.
